title: Dollar General Corporation: FDA Enforcement & Food Safety Record
excerpt: Dollar General faces a mounting regulatory profile spanning 25 FDA recall actions, a $12M OSHA settlement, and growing scrutiny over discount retail food safety failures — all while operating 20,000+ stores where consumables account for 82% of revenue.
seo_title: Dollar General FDA Enforcement Actions & Food Safety Record | Policy Canary
seo_description: Comprehensive analysis of Dollar General's FDA enforcement history, including 25 recall actions, OSHA's $12M settlement, temperature excursion failures, and the discount retail food safety crisis highlighted by the WanaBana lead-contaminated applesauce outbreak.

key_deadlines.description: OSHA settlement compliance: quarterly safety reports due to OSHA, third-party auditor engagement required
FDA Class II classification issued for temperature excursion recall affecting dairy, frozen, and refrigerated products
